name: The Stone Roses

whyMatters.en: Manchester band formed in 1983. The Stone Roses (1989, produced by John Leckie) fused indie jangle with dance grooves; Fools Gold’s extended 12" form predates Britpop’s mid-90s chart boom and is often cited by Oasis.
whyMatters.zh: 曼彻斯特乐队，1983 年成立。《The Stone Roses》（1989，John Leckie 制作）把 indie jangle 与舞曲 groove 结合；《Fools Gold》延长 12" 形态早于 Britpop 90 年代中期榜单热潮，常被 Oasis 引用。

lyricQuotes: The past was yours / But the future's mine

shortBio.en: Madchester guitar-dance four. Fools Gold is the extended groove single; the 1989 debut is the main Britpop preface.
shortBio.zh: Madchester 吉他—舞曲四人组。《Fools Gold》是延长 groove 单曲；1989 首专是主要 Britpop 前言。

body.en:
The Stone Roses formed in Manchester in 1983. John Leckie’s production on The Stone Roses (1989) set Ian Brown’s flat vocal, John Squire’s wah/jangle leads, Mani’s melodic bass, and Reni’s funk drums—the guitar side of baggy/Madchester culture.

Fools Gold (1989) is the best-known extended 12". Second Coming (1994) followed legal delays and lineup strain; Reni left during that period. The catalog is short; Oasis and other Britpop guitar bands still cite the debut.

Brown, Squire, Andy Couzens, Pete Garner, and Simon Wolstencroft started in the Manchester area in 1983, after playing around Altrincham from 1980. Wolstencroft left in 1984; Alan “Reni” Wren took the drums. When Garner left in 1987, Gary “Mani” Mounfield took bass. Sally Cinnamon (1987) and Elephant Stone (1988) are the first singles they stood by. The Stone Roses (1989) drew the UK press. With Happy Mondays they are the Madchester pair in the entry. Fools Gold is the 1989 single. A label fight stopped the live run. One Love (1990) was the last single for four years.

Second Coming (1994) has Love Spreads, Ten Storey Love Song, and Begging You, all UK hits. Reni left. Robbie Maddix played drums and Nigel Ipinson-Fleming added keys. Squire left to form The Seahorses. Aziz Ibrahim played guitar until the end of 1996. Brown’s solo work continued. Mani joined Primal Scream. The Seahorses ended in 1999. In 2011 Brown, Squire, Reni, and Mani reunited; 2012 festival bills sold out. Squire also sat in with Oasis; that date is on the Oasis page.
body.zh:
The Stone Roses 于 1983 年在曼彻斯特成立。John Leckie 制作的《The Stone Roses》（1989）定型 Ian Brown 平人声、John Squire wah/jangle 主音、Mani 旋律贝斯与 Reni funk 鼓——baggy/Madchester 文化的吉他一面。

《Fools Gold》（1989）是最知名的延长 12"。《Second Coming》（1994）在法律拖延与阵容紧张后推出；Reni 在该时期离队。目录虽短，Oasis 等 Britpop 吉他乐队仍常引用首专。

Brown、Squire、Andy Couzens、Pete Garner 与 Simon Wolstencroft 1983 年在曼彻斯特一带正式组建，1980 年起已在奥尔特灵厄姆附近演出。Wolstencroft 1984 年离开，Alan “Reni” Wren 接鼓。Garner 1987 年离开，Gary “Mani” Mounfield 接贝斯。《Sally Cinnamon》（1987）与《Elephant Stone》（1988）是他们认的第一批单曲。《The Stone Roses》（1989）在英国得到集中报道。条目里他们与 Happy Mondays 并列为 Madchester。《Fools Gold》是 1989 年单曲。厂牌官司打断了现场。《One Love》（1990）之后四年没有新单曲。

《Second Coming》（1994）里《Love Spreads》《Ten Storey Love Song》《Begging You》都是英国热单。Reni 离队。Robbie Maddix 打鼓，Nigel Ipinson-Fleming 加键盘。Squire 离开去组 The Seahorses。Aziz Ibrahim 担任吉他，直到 1996 年年末结束。Brown 继续个人作品。Mani 加入 Primal Scream。The Seahorses 1999 年解散。2011 年 Brown、Squire、Reni、Mani 重组；2012 年多场音乐节门票售罄。Squire 也曾与 Oasis 同台，写在 Oasis 条目里。

note.en: Reverse-gated intro into Squire wah/jangle; Leckie debut album opener.
note.zh: 反向门限前奏接 Squire wah/jangle；Leckie 制作首专开场。

note.en: Nine-minute 12" groove; Mani bass loop, Reni funk hi-hats, Brown slack vocal.
note.zh: 九分钟 12" groove；Mani 贝斯循环、Reni funk 踩镲、Brown 松弛人声。

note.en: Second Coming lead single; heavier Squire riff after a five-year gap.
note.zh: 《Second Coming》主打；五年间隔后更重的 Squire riff。

body.en:
The 1989 debut merges indie jangle with dance-floor length. Fools Gold runs on bass/drum loop more than short verse-chorus radio form. She Bangs the Drums adds tambourine-driven mid-tempo lift.

Madchester fact: a guitar band borrowing club groove mechanics.
body.zh:
1989 首专合并 indie jangle 与舞池时长。《Fools Gold》更多靠贝斯/鼓循环，而非短主副歌电台形态。《She Bangs the Drums》加入铃鼓驱动的中速抬升。

Madchester 事实：吉他乐队借用 club groove 机制。

title.zh: 经典四人组与 Second Coming

body.en:
Peak lineup: Brown vocal, Squire guitar, Mani bass, Reni drums. Reni exits mid-1990s sessions; Second Coming ships heavier, Zeppelin-leaning riffs with less of the debut’s dance length.

2011–2017 reunion restores the four names on festival stages.

Mani arrives in 1987 from Garner’s bass chair. The 2011 return is the debut four. Squire’s Oasis guest spot is the shared live date.
body.zh:
巅峰阵容：Brown 人声、Squire 吉他、Mani 贝斯、Reni 鼓。Reni 在 1990 年代中期录音期间离队；《Second Coming》交出更重、偏 Zeppelin 的 riff，舞曲时长减少。

2011–2017 重聚在音乐节恢复四人名。

Mani 1987 年接 Garner 的贝斯。2011 年回来的是首专四人。Squire 给 Oasis 当客席是两边共用的现场。

alt.en: The Stone Roses in Milan, 17 July 2012
alt.zh: The Stone Roses，米兰，2012 年 7 月 17 日

title.en: Cited by Oasis and Britpop guitar bands
title.zh: 被 Oasis 与 Britpop 吉他乐队引用

body.en:
Oasis and Blur both cite the 1989 album’s confidence and Squire’s guitar color. The catalog is short; the debut’s influence on mid-90s UK guitar bands is long.

Fools Gold showed UK guitar bands could hold club-length form on vinyl.
body.zh:
Oasis 与 Blur 均引用 1989 专辑的自信与 Squire 吉他色彩。目录短；首专对 90 年代中期英国吉他乐队的影响长。

《Fools Gold》表明英国吉他乐队可在黑胶上维持 club 长度形态。

body.en: Reverse-gated intro into Squire wah/jangle; Leckie debut album opener.
body.zh: 反向门限前奏接 Squire wah/jangle；Leckie 制作首专开场。

body.zh: 《Second Coming》主打；更重的 Squire riff，延迟五年的续作。

interviewQuotes.text: We wanted to be the best band since The Beatles—and say it out loud.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Ian Brown

interviewQuotes.text: The drums have to swing like dance music or it isn't Madchester.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Reni

note.en:
Squire jangle and Reni swing; 1989 debut as Madchester peak record.

Debut four is Brown, Squire, Mani, Reni. Couzens, Garner, and Wolstencroft are the 1983 chairs. Maddix and Ipinson-Fleming cover the last year.
note.zh:
Squire jangle 与 Reni 摇摆；1989 首专即 Madchester 巅峰录音。

首专四人是 Brown、Squire、Mani、Reni。Couzens、Garner、Wolstencroft 是 1983 年的位子。最后一年是 Maddix 与 Ipinson-Fleming。

note.en: Bass-led opener from the Leckie debut.
note.zh: Leckie 制作首专的贝斯领衔开场。

note.en: Baggy/Madchester indie into dance-rock; short catalog, long citation trail.
note.zh: Baggy/Madchester indie 进舞曲摇滚；目录短，引用链长。
